    • TpSpeechToText

    Class TpSpeechToText

    transcribes microphone speech into editable text using the Web Speech API.

    Example

    <tp-speech-to-text lang="en-US" interim-results></tp-speech-to-text>

    Tagname

    tp-speech-to-text

    Attr

    value = "" - Final transcript, editable without microphone access.

    Attr

    continuous = false - Requests multiple recognition results in one session.

    Attr

    interim-results = false - Displays provisional recognition separately from the final transcript.

    Attr

    disabled = false - Disables editing and recognition and stops any active session. tp-speech-to-text-start Emitted when recognition starts listening.

    Eventdetail

    tp-speech-to-text-start { value: string } tp-speech-to-text-result Emitted when recognition updates its transcript.

    Eventdetail

    tp-speech-to-text-result { value: string; interim: string } tp-speech-to-text-end Emitted when recognition ends or is aborted.

    Eventdetail

    tp-speech-to-text-end { value: string } tp-speech-to-text-error Emitted when recognition fails or is unavailable.

    Eventdetail

    tp-speech-to-text-error { error: string }

    Accessibility

    Uses labelled native controls through tp-button and tp-textfield, with a polite status region and a keyboard-editable transcript.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Explain microphone permission and possible remote audio processing; never require speech as the only input method.

    Keyboard

    Moves between playback controls and the transcript field.

    Keyboard

    Activates a focused button.
